label: D2 reset dip deepens late in episode, less after reward, more after a2/S2
terms: (phase == D2) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 89, 0) ;; (phase == D2) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 89, 0)**2 ;; (phase == D2) * table(3*action+state, {4: 1, 5: -1, 7: 0.5, 8: -1}) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 79, 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 79, 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 79, 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 79, 0)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 30 sits near 1 at D1/GO. At D2 it dips, and the dip grows sharply over the last ~10-20 trials of the episode (timing alone gives R^2 0.85). Beyond timing, nearly all the variance is at D2 and in that late part of the episode. (1) A within-decile ramp in ep_trial over trials 90-99 (D2 drops from about 0.85 to about 0.3) adds a lot that the per-decile baseline misses. (2) The D2 choice x state: a1->S1 common is highest, a1->S2 / a2->S2 are lowest. (3) A ramp from trial 80 interacted with the observed history: after a rewarded previous trial (and, weakly, the trial before) r stays higher, and when this trial chose a2 or reached S2 it dips further. Overall r dips more late in the episode after a run of unrewarded trials and a2/S2. D1/GO residuals are tiny (<0.01) and left unmodelled. Every term is observed at D2. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.60, well above the phase-additive all ceiling of 0.29, because the ramp terms capture within-decile time and its interaction with history. Adding the value head gives only 0.62. Not modelled: slow window-specific drift (some late windows run 0.1-0.2 below prediction).

issues: Minor overclaim: 'D1 and GO residuals are tiny (under 0.01)' holds on average (misses: mean error D1 -0.001, GO -0.001), but in late windows GO and D1 sit 0.05-0.16 below the prediction (e.g. t95-96 GO 0.80 vs 0.97 predicted). Four GO/D1 late-ramp x prev_reward terms on their own explain only 0.011 test R^2, so leaving them out costs little variance.

Minor overclaim: 'a1->S2 and a2->S2 are lowest'. The profile's D2 residuals by choice x state are a1S1 +0.023, a1S2 -0.005, a2S1 +0.010, a2S2 -0.022, so a1->S2 sits in the middle and is not tied with a2->S2. Setting the a1S2 weight to 0 barely changes test R^2 (0.574 vs 0.576).

The 'rewarded trial before that' term is very weak: dropping tv('reward',-2) changes test R^2 from 0.576 to 0.570. 'More weakly' is accurate, but 'a run of unrewarded trials' leans almost entirely on prev_reward.

Claims confirmed by ablation on test. Ramp alone gives 0.15 and ramp + table 0.30. Removing the prev_reward x ramp term drops test R^2 to 0.43; removing the state==2 / action==2 x ramp terms drops it to 0.39. The full set gives 0.576 test, well above the additive 'all' ceiling of 0.29.

Remaining gap: the worst windows sit low at every phase across the whole window (a per-episode drift). None of the observable cues I tried captures it: common, prev_state, prev_action, abs(choice), good, a 3-trial reward count, or the last-trial pattern x ramp, each adding at most +0.003. Value adds +0.01 (test 0.586). An exponential ramp (tau=8) instead of the hinge ramp gives 0.592 test. The explanation already admits this drift, so it is not a hidden error class.
